svg.title: Tail of optical FIFO waiting time
svg.desc: T1–T4 · Nearest-rank estimates per seed · Panel scales vary with class and metric Dotted rings flag limited tail support in at least one measured seed. Missing observations have no marker.

g.text: Tail of optical FIFO waiting time
T1–T4 · Nearest-rank estimates per seed · Panel scales vary with class and metric
Points = seed mean | Whiskers = seed min–max
Dotted rings flag limited tail support in at least one measured seed. Missing observations have no marker.
